latestVersion.changelog:
Video Letter Maker Online — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill: create and send personalized AI-generated video letters using your photos, text, and audio.
- Supports easy uploads (JPG, PNG, MP4, MP3, up to 200MB) and 1080p MP4 downloads—no video editing skills required.
- Automatic session and authentication flow; 100 free credits for new users.
- Guides users with plain prompts (e.g., “turn my written message and photos into a video letter for my friend”).
- Fast cloud-based rendering (30–90 seconds typical turnaround).
- In-app workflow includes upload, status, credits, and export commands, with helpful error handling and plain language instructions.
